title: Require successful Buffalo native warmup before readiness
purpose: Correct audit finding 5: configure the actual dynamic-input Buffalo detector and prevent readiness from admitting native inference failures.
success_outcome: Buffalo becomes ready only after both native model paths infer successfully; dynamic-input local ONNX models then process a synthetic Photo, and native failure rejects serving/Calibration admission without fallback.
verify: 2026-09-07 independent /verify: functional PASS for FT-002-AC-009. Fresh 26-test gate, actual native non-skipped 1-test gate, 16-case serving/Calibration composition probe, mypy 94 files and mb-lint passed. Evidence: .protocols/TASK-114-T3-FT-002-W6/verification.md and .tasks/TASK-114-T3-FT-002-W6/TASK-114-T3-FT-002-W6-S-VERIFY-final-report-code-01.md. verify.summary: Attempt 1 closed by delegated /autopilot after independent functional PASS and separate task semantic-pass for FT-002-AC-009. Original genuine native RED is retained; current 26-test gate, non-skipped ONNX test, 16 consumer failure cases, mypy and lint passed. Resume required no additional implementation. No production acceptance remains for this task; no deployment or operator/default data was touched.

anti_goals: Do not change SFace, EXIF orientation, Photo admission/derivatives, realtime request/concurrency, search semantics or Calibration datasets/calculations.
Do not add model downloads, new dependencies, model files to Git, mutable model/revision identity, configuration layers, runtime registries, fallback or simultaneous dual-pipeline preload.
Do not change deployment, process counts, database state/schema, operator assets or selected serving revision; do not reopen historical task evidence.

forbidden_scope: Runtime files outside buffalo_adapter.py, including model_admission.py and all entrypoints
SFace, EXIF/inventory/derivative implementation, realtime tasks TASK-112/TASK-113, FT-003 and testing/client-realtime.md
Dependencies/lockfiles, models directory writes, migrations, deployment and production data
stop_conditions: Required local ONNX files are absent or the native regression cannot execute; do not replace its proof with skipped tests or doubles.
Correctness requires changing accepted pipeline identity, selecting/deploying assets, changing a public contract or writing outside the hard boundary.

constraints: Owner is processing at src/face_moment/processing/. Consumers are existing Photo worker/realtime model binding and the held Calibration direct-adapter admission; propagate errors through their current ModelAdmissionError boundary, without changes to foreign owners or entrypoints.

In from_configured_assets, retain exact asset/revision checks and native taskname validation, then prepare the detector for CPU with input_size=(640, 640). Installed InsightFace RetinaFace.prepare sets dynamic dimensions and preserves a model-embedded fixed size. Keep native detection/alignment/normalization and no download/fallback.

Track adapter readiness false initially. warmup resets it false, verifies assets, performs actual detector inference, and separately calls the native recognizer get path using a synthetic BGR image and valid five-point landmarks. A blank detector result must not skip recognizer warmup. Validate finite normalized embedding with the revision dimension; only then set ready true. This discarded synthetic inference creates no Photo, face rows, query or result.

Wrap native load/prepare/warmup failures at the Buffalo boundary as BuffaloAdapterError (a ValueError), preserving the cause; both existing admit_selected_model and admit_selected_calibration_adapter already translate ValueError to ModelAdmissionError. Keep false on failure, including a failed repeated warmup. No generic admission refactor is necessary.

Use actual read-only local models/insightface_buffalo_m/scrfd.onnx and w600k_r50.onnx, currently present. Build only a temporary in-memory EligiblePipelineRevision matching the actual assets/identity/checksums and dimension 512, reusing existing test helpers. Do not persist, alter or infer a production serving revision.

Add the exact native test node named in gates. It must execute and pass for task closure; a skip is not acceptance. Preserve ordinary native-path/mismatch tests, adjusting doubles only to implement the real prepare/warmup contract rather than masking calls. No claimed recognition-accuracy benchmark is required.

Read fixture setup before DB-backed admission tests and run with .env.local; any fixture-owned databases/assets are disposed/removed without touching operator/default state. Native probe itself needs no database, commercial image or production restart.

Execute sequentially after the owner selects this reviewed task. Runtime implementation has no dependency on TASK-112/TASK-113; shared consumers do not authorize parallel canonical execution. Initial execution records honest RED, then verify and per-task red-verify precede explicit owner closure.
invariants: ready is false until both native model calls succeed and remains false after native load/warmup failure.
Configured assets, revision/checksums, native alignment and embedding isolation remain authoritative; no fallback or cross-pipeline data is used.
Synthetic warmup is discarded and never mutates Photo/Attempt/Calibration state or the selected serving revision.
verification_targets: FT-002-AC-009 / REQ-SRCH-001: real local dynamic-input ONNX detector and recognizer through BuffaloPhotoAdapter.from_configured_assets; observe unready-before-warmup, both real session inference calls, ready-after-success and process_photo(np.zeros((320,320,3), uint8)) without AssertionError. Record dynamic input shape, configured detector size, asset checksum identity and finite normalized 512-dimensional recognizer result, not embedding values.

FT-002-AC-009: detector-empty warmup still runs the recognizer; independent load/prepare/detector/recognizer failure, invalid embedding dimension/nonfinite normalization, and failed repeated warmup leave readiness false. Through existing serving and Calibration admission functions, verify these Buffalo failures become ModelAdmissionError and no adapter is returned.

Use existing role-admission fail-closed tests as affected-consumer regression; preserve SFace, asset mismatch and native processing tests without adopting original AC-007/008 or TASK-026 restart proof. Scope is actual native readiness only.

RED is the production configured dynamic detector with input_size None and reported ready despite no inference; GREEN uses the same real assets and comparable synthetic input after correction. Do not use malformed fake weights or a skip as the native RED/GREEN. Retain finite test outcomes and readiness/native-call trace under the task artifact directory.

No new mutable persistence is introduced: in-memory revision and discarded arrays suffice for native proof. Existing admission fixture setup/teardown establishes safe rerun when database-backed consumer tests run.
evidence_required: FT-002-AC-009 RED: the current configured native dynamic-input detector reports ready without inference and processing the synthetic 320x320 image raises AssertionError; GREEN: the same real local models complete detector and recognizer warmup before readiness and process the image without that failure, while injected native failures close serving/Calibration admission; decisive comparison: native-call trace, detector input size, ready transitions, dimension/finite-normalization checks and admission exception type; artifact: non-skipped native regression plus focused failure-matrix transcript under .tasks/TASK-114-T3-FT-002-W6/.
